Neon ring and streak lines sweep across the background; small yellow sparkle dashes flank the bottom pill.

title: Web Development Learning Guide
prompt:
[Format]
Landscape 16:9 gig cover, flat catalogue layout on a pale textured beige field: a two-row grid of small logo tiles plus one small mascot illustration. Matte card texture, flat vector marks. No watermark, no personal names.

[Layout]
The midline of the frame is occupied by a two-row tile grid. Row one holds five tiles of unequal width on a shared baseline with even gutters: the WordPress mark in a white square, the JavaScript logo in a bright yellow square, the PHP logo in a wide slate-blue ellipse, then the CSS3 badge in a tall blue shield and the HTML5 badge in a tall orange-red shield. Row two holds five wordmark-style items on a looser baseline, spaced wider, mixing pictorial marks with lowercase lettering: the MySQL wordmark, an orange-and-blue two-colour wordmark with a small blue leaping-dolphin silhouette above it, then the jQuery mark, a blue circular mark of nested arcs beside a lowercase name, then the Git mark, a red tilted diamond with a white branch glyph beside a lowercase name, and the GitHub mark, a small black cat-head silhouette beside a lowercase name. Above the grid, a purple uppercase question line spans the upper-left two-thirds and a small flat vector character stands at the top-right, about a fifth of the frame in height.

[Subject]
No photograph. The only figure is a flat vector illustration at the top-right: a young woman with an orange hair bun, a dark charcoal top and a light teal tablet held in front of her, drawn in clean flat shapes with simple dot eyes and a small smile.

[Headline]
One line of purple extra-bold uppercase sans, left-aligned with a wide margin about a third of the way down the frame: 'YOU WILL LEARN?' — the only text on the cover apart from the small wordmarks in the tiles.

[Badges]
The tile grid is the badge layer — nine real tech logos, each drawn with its own mark and wordmark. Row one, left to right: the WordPress mark, a white square holding a blue-grey double-outline circle crossed by a thin white diagonal; the JavaScript logo, a bright yellow square with two black angled 'JS' characters; the PHP logo, a slate-blue ellipse with the white lowercase letters 'php'; the CSS3 badge, a blue vertical shield with a small 'CSS' label and a white notched chevron; and the HTML5 badge, a red-orange vertical shield with a large white numeral '5'. Row two, left to right: the MySQL mark, an orange-and-blue wordmark under a small blue leaping-dolphin silhouette; the jQuery mark, a blue disc of nested crescent arcs beside the lowercase wordmark 'jQuery'; the Git mark, a red tilted diamond with a white branching glyph beside the lowercase wordmark 'git'; and the GitHub mark, a black cat-head silhouette beside the lowercase wordmark 'github'. Keep each mark's size, shape family and colour.

[Mood]
Warm off-white beige, saturated primaries and one purple line; a catalogue, checklist feel. The purple headline plus the colourful tile grid read at any size.

title: WordPress Life Coach Website Gig Cover
prompt:

[Layout]
An off-white field fills the frame with a soft out-of-focus green plant along the right edge. The left 45% is a text column set on the field: a small kicker, a two-line headline, a sub-headline, four circular icons, a two-row ticked checklist, a dark green rounded button at the bottom-left, and a handwritten script annotation with a thin curved arrow curling back up toward it. The right 55% holds the devices: a laptop in near-frontal three-quarter view with a coaching site on screen, the largest block in the frame, plus an upright phone at the lower right overlapping the laptop's right edge and cropped by the corner, standing in front of screen and field. A logo lockup with its own script annotation and curved arrow sits top-right above the group.

[Subject]
none — no cut-out person; the cover is type, icons and screens. The only human is a photograph inside the laptop mockup: a woman in three-quarter profile, shoulders-up, head tipped back, eyes closed, light top, hair up.

[Headline]
Reading order: the kicker "MODERN | RESPONSIVE | SEO FRIENDLY" in small dark-grey letter-spaced capitals; the headline "WordPress" in heavy near-black sans over "Life Coach Website" in dark green, flush left, each line about a tenth of the frame height; the sub-headline "Get More Clients • Book Sessions • Grow Your Coaching Business"; four icon labels in small black capitals — "Calendly Booking", "Mobile Responsive", "SEO Optimized", "Essential Plugins"; a two-column ticked checklist of coaching roles in small black capitals; a dark green rounded button with white text "Let's Build Your Site" and a right arrow; and the handwritten dark-green script "Your Coaching Journey Starts Here" over two lines with a curved arrow beneath. Inside the laptop screen: a coaching logo, a six-item nav, a green "Book a Session" button, a serif hero headline "Your Best Self Starts Here" and three icon-and-label pairs.

[Badges]
Top-right: the WordPress mark — a dark circle outline holding a stylised "W" with a crossed flourish, about a seventeenth of the frame width — with "WORDPRESS" in grey caps beside it and a hand-drawn dark-green script line "Built for Your Success" beneath, its arrow sweeping down toward the laptop. The first icon-row item pairs a thin calendar glyph with the label "Calendly Booking".

[Mood]
Bright airy SaaS white — off-white field, near-black type, forest-green accents. Thin and low-contrast apart from the headline lines and the green button, so at thumbnail size the black "WordPress" line and the glowing laptop screen land first.
